def analyze(g, out, target_color, rsep, csep, H, W):
    rg=groups(H,rsep); cg=groups(W,csep)
    fives=[(x,y) for x in range(H) for y in range(W) if g[x][y]==target_color]
    colc=Counter(y for x,y in fives); rowc=Counter(x for x,y in fives)
    d1c=Counter(y-x for x,y in fives); d2c=Counter(x+y for x,y in fives)
    res={}
    for i,r in enumerate(rg):
        for j,c in enumerate(cg):
            ps=[(x,y) for x in r for y in c if g[x][y]==target_color]
            feats={}
            feats['cnt']=len(ps)
            if ps:
                feats['colc_sum']=sum(colc[y] for x,y in ps)
                feats['colc_max']=max(colc[y] for x,y in ps)
                feats['colc_min']=min(colc[y] for x,y in ps)
                feats['rowc_max']=max(rowc[x] for x,y in ps)
                feats['d1_max']=max(d1c[y-x] for x,y in ps)
                feats['d2_max']=max(d2c[x+y] for x,y in ps)
                feats['within_col']=ps[0][1]-c[0] if len(ps)==1 else None
                feats['within_row']=ps[0][0]-r[0] if len(ps)==1 else None
                feats['adj']=sum(1 for a in ps for b in ps if a<b and (abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])==1))
            res[(i,j)]=(feats,out[i][j])
    return res

import itertools, math
def make_stats(B, rg, cg, out):
    allf=[p for v in B.values() for p in v]
    colc={}; rowc={}
    for p in allf: colc[p[1]]=colc.get(p[1],0)+1; rowc[p[0]]=rowc.get(p[0],0)+1
    nR,nC=len(rg),len(cg); cnts_=cnts(B)
    S={}
    for (i,j),ps in B.items():
        rgx,cgx=rg[i],cg[j]
        s=dict(out=out[i][j], cnt=len(ps),
               colc_max=max(colc[p[1]] for p in ps),
               colc_sum=sum(colc[p[1]] for p in ps),
               rowc_max=max(rowc[p[0]] for p in ps),
               same_col_in_cg=sum(colc[p[1]] for p in ps),   # == colc since five in cg j has col in cg j
               same_row_in_rg=sum(rowc[p[0]] for p in ps),
               cg_total=sum(cnts_[(i2,j)] for i2 in range(nR)),
               rg_total=sum(cnts_[(i,j2)] for j2 in range(nC)),
               nblocks_cg=sum(1 for i2 in range(nR) if cnts_[(i2,j)]>0),
               nblocks_rg=sum(1 for j2 in range(nC) if cnts_[(i,j2)]>0),
               nb=sum(1 for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0) and (i+di,j+dj) in cnts_ and cnts_[(i+di,j+dj)]>0),
               wr=sorted(p[0]-rgx[0] for p in ps), wc=sorted(p[1]-cgx[0] for p in ps),
               )
        if len(ps)==2:
            (a,b),(c,d)=ps
            s['align_v']=int(a==c); s['align_h']=int(b==d)
        else:
            s['align_v']=0; s['align_h']=0
        S[(i,j)]=s
    return S

# Full listing of per-block (wr, wc, colc, rowc, out) for both demos
def enrich(B, rg, cg, out):
    allf=[p for v in B.values() for p in v]
    colc=Counter(p[1] for p in allf); rowc=Counter(p[0] for p in allf)
    rows=[]
    for (i,j),ps in sorted(B.items()):
        for p in ps:
            rows.append(dict(b=(i,j), wr=p[0]-rg[i][0], wc=p[1]-cg[j][0],
                             colc=colc[p[1]], rowc=rowc[p[0]], o=out[i][j]))
    return rows
R1=enrich(B1,rg1,cg1,d1out); R2=enrich(B2,rg2,cg2,d2out)
print("d1 fives (wr,wc,colc,rowc,out):")
for r in R1: print(r)
print("\nd2 out=3 fives:", [(r['b'],r['wr'],r['wc'],r['colc'],r['rowc']) for r in R2 if r['o']==3])
# collision checks
d1_0 = set((r['wr'],r['wc']) for r in R1 if r['o']==0)
d2_3 = set((r['wr'],r['wc']) for r in R2 if r['o']==3)
print("\n(wr,wc) collision d1out0 vs d2out3:", d1_0 & d2_3)
d1_0c = set((r['colc'],r['wr']) for r in R1 if r['o']==0)
d2_3c = set((r['colc'],r['wr']) for r in R2 if r['o']==3)
print("(colc,wr) collision:", d1_0c & d2_3c)
d1_0w = set(r['wc'] for r in R1 if r['o']==0)
print("d1 out0 wc values:", sorted(d1_0w), " d2 out3 wc:", sorted(set(r['wc'] for r in R2 if r['o']==3)))
d1_0wr = set(r['wr'] for r in R1 if r['o']==0)
print("d1 out0 wr values:", sorted(d1_0wr), " d2 out3 wr:", sorted(set(r['wr'] for r in R2 if r['o']==3)))
d1_0colc = sorted(set(r['colc'] for r in R1 if r['o']==0))
d2_3colc = sorted(set(r['colc'] for r in R2 if r['o']==3))
print("d1 out0 colc:", d1_0colc, " d2 out3 colc:", d2_3colc)

def gen_features(B, rg, cg, out):
    nR,nC=len(rg),len(cg)
    allf=[p for v in B.values() for p in v]
    colc=Counter(p[1] for p in allf); rowc=Counter(p[0] for p in allf)
    cnts_=cnts(B)
    feats={}
    for (i,j),ps in B.items():
        f={}
        f['cnt']=len(ps)
        f['colc_max']=max(colc[p[1]] for p in ps)
        f['colc_min']=min(colc[p[1]] for p in ps)
        f['colc_sum']=sum(colc[p[1]] for p in ps)
        f['rowc_max']=max(rowc[p[0]] for p in ps)
        f['rowc_min']=min(rowc[p[0]] for p in ps)
        f['rowc_sum']=sum(rowc[p[0]] for p in ps)
        # blocks in cg j having a five in same column as block's fives (distinct cols)
        f['cg_blocks_samecol']=max(len({(p[1], i2) for i2 in range(nR) for q in B[(i2,j)] if q[1]==p[1]}) for p in ps)
        # blocks in rg i having a five in same row
        f['rg_blocks_samerow']=max(len({(p[0], j2) for j2 in range(nC) for q in B[(i,j2)] if q[0]==p[0]}) for p in ps)
        # distinct row-groups of fives sharing column
        f['rgs_samecol']=max(len({q[0]//len(rg[0]) for q in allf if q[1]==p[1]}) for p in ps)
        f['rgs_samerow']=max(len({q[0]//len(rg[0]) for q in allf if q[0]==p[0]}) for p in ps)
        # fives sharing row or col (others)
        f['others_rowcol']=sum(1 for q in allf if q!=p and (q[0]==p[0] or q[1]==p[1])) if len(ps)==1 else -1
        # min/max over fives of (colc+rowc-1) etc
        f['max_rowcol_share']=max(sum(1 for q in allf if q!=p and (q[0]==p[0] or q[1]==p[1]))+1 for p in ps)
        f['max_line']=max(max(colc[p[1]],rowc[p[0]]) for p in ps)
        f['min_line']=min(max(colc[p[1]],rowc[p[0]]) for p in ps)
        f['max_colc_rowc_min']=max(min(colc[p[1]],rowc[p[0]]) for p in ps)
        f['cg_total']=sum(cnts_[(i2,j)] for i2 in range(nR))
        f['rg_total']=sum(cnts_[(i,j2)] for j2 in range(nC))
        f['cnt_x_colc']=len(ps)*max(colc[p[1]] for p in ps)
        f['out']=out[i][j]
        feats[(i,j)]=f
    return feats

# Final verification of the chosen rule on both demos, then the test prediction
def apply_rule(B, rg, cg, out):
    allf=[p for v in B.values() for p in v]
    rowc=Counter(p[0] for p in allf)
    pred={}
    for (i,j),ps in B.items():
        if len(ps)==2: pred[(i,j)]=1
        elif len(ps)==1: pred[(i,j)]=3 if rowc[ps[0][0]]>=3 else 0
        else: pred[(i,j)]=0
    ok=all(pred[(i,j)]==out[i][j] for i in range(len(rg)) for j in range(len(cg)))
